note: Christmas Island's bank is a branch of an Australian bank numbered in Australia's own BSB system: AusPayNet's BSB Directory (the full file, read 2026-10-30; AusPayNet administers the BSB System and updates the file monthly) lists Westpac's Christmas Island branch, Canberra Place, postcode 6798, at BSB 036-189 (and 736-189), and its key gives WBC as Westpac Banking Corporation, prefixes 03, 04, 73 and 74; Westpac's own branch locator (read 2026-10-30) gives the same branch and BSB. So an account there is numbered as one in Australia, a BSB and an account number.
